name: Momotarou Gaiden Momoko-chan Fight
original_name: 桃太郎外伝ももこちゃんファイト
source:
Story is based on Momotaro classic fairy-tale. Momokodokoro goes to fight demon marauders, but their leader princess Kokeshi easily seduces him.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/05/vn-of-month-december-1991.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
故事取材于桃太郎经典童话故事。Momokodokoro去与恶魔掠夺者战斗，但他们的首领公主Kokeshi轻易地引诱了他。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/05/vn-of-month-december-1991.html]vndbreview[/url]]
